claims.text: Entropy gradient theorem: every self-modeling composite with rho_exp > 0 satisfies S(t) < S_max, established via three independent routes using different assumption subsets.
Landauer bound on self-modeling: each update cycle dissipates at least kB T I(B;M) of work.
Three-consequence theorem: the single choice u in S^6 determines gauge group, chirality, AND the requirement for spacetime time-orientation.
Gap C narrowing: complexification is necessary for SM-like observers; status of non-SM self-modelers in non-complexified blocks remains open.
Two-chain convergence on time-orientation is a 'genuine structural insight connecting particle physics to thermodynamics through geometry.'
The Past Hypothesis is 'elevated' from observed cosmological fact to necessary condition for self-modeling -- an observer-selection argument, not a first-principles derivation.
SWAP channel on qubit pair is CPTP and unital for rho_M = I/2, proved not assumed.
Chain 1 (thermodynamic) applies to ALL self-modelers regardless of chirality or complexification.
The 94-order-of-magnitude gap between Landauer entropy deficit (~10^28 nats) and Penrose gravitational estimate (~10^122 nats) is a feature of the framework, not a failure.
Coherence loophole closed via three independent arguments: Luders destroys coherence, maintaining coherence costs free energy, Sagawa-Ueda cross-check.
